verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a community report that a Stripe PM confirmed multi-currency subscriptions work by creating a separate plan per currency (e.g. bronze_plan:eur). That is a product-native, if manual, way to set per-currency price points. No first-party docs in the pack cover multi-currency billing, and nothing shows consolidated reporting converted to a home currency; the generic analytics and revenue-recognition items do not mention currency conversion. Missing for 10: first-party docs on local-currency billing and per-currency prices, consolidated home-currency reporting or FX conversion, multi-currency handling without duplicating plans, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can bill customers in their local currency with per-currency price points and consolidated reporting in my home currency

citations.quote: For multi-currency subscriptions, Stripe PM confirmed you currently need to create a separate plan per currency (e.g. bronze_plan:eur)
